div.h2: Code of Conduct for Child and Youth Protection and Safeguarding
div.h3: Child and Youth Protection Standards: These are the behaviors that are expected toward all children and youth, regardless of their affiliation with programming or status as a participant.

ul.li: I will demonstrate respect for all children and youth. I will not engage in behaviors or use language that humiliates, belittles, degrades or harms a child or youth.
I recognize that I am accountable for my response to a child or youth’s behavior; even when a child or youth behaves in a physically inappropriate or sexually suggestive manner.

I will never engage in any romantic relationship or sexual/sexually suggestive behavior, including in person and digital/virtual interactions, with anyone under age 18, even if it is legal according to local law. Stating I did not know the person’s true age is not a valid excuse.

I will not condone or participate in illegal, unsafe, coercive or abusive behavior of any child or youth, including physical or sexual assault, emotional abuse, in-person or online exploitation, trafficking, harmful traditional practices, and spiritual or ritualistic abuse.
I will not involve myself in a marriage (whether registered or unregistered marriages) with anyone under the age of 18, regardless of cultural/religious beliefs or legal age of marriage.

I will not hire any child or force/compel a child to engage in any form of work that is mentally, physically, socially, or morally dangerous and harmful to children or youth, or that interferes with their education. If I want to employ a child or youth, I will make sure the work supports his or her development. I will follow all local laws regarding child employment.

div.h3: Safeguarding Standards: These are the expectations for behaviors expected specifically in the context of programming at the child and youth development center and with program participants, regardless of age.

ul.li: I will always uphold the trust and confidence placed in me as a child and youth advocate to protect children and youth and serve their best interests. I will conduct myself in a way that safeguards participants from all forms of abuse, neglect and exploitation.

I will treat all participants with dignity and respect, regardless of their gender, age, race, religion, social background, culture, special needs or disability. I will contribute to creating an environment where children or youth are respected and encouraged to discuss their concerns and rights.
I will only engage in activities and relationships with participants that are in line with biblical principles, and appropriate to their age and developmental abilities.

I understand that I have power and authority in relation to participants and their caregivers, even if I do not feel like a powerful person. I will avoid situations where I could abuse my influence or misuse my power for my personal advantage.
I will submit to the lawfully permitted background or police checks as requested prior to any real-time (in-person or digital) contact with participants or access to their personal information.

I will engage in program-related activities with participants only in open or visible places. In the event that an activity needs to take place in an enclosed space, I will follow the “two adult rule,” and ensure that at least one other approved adult is with me.

If I am aware of any actual or potential abuse, neglect or exploitation of participants, I will follow the process for raising concerns. If I do not know the process, I will find out and follow it. I will respect the privacy of everyone involved and only share incident information with others who will be investigating the allegations and supporting the appropriate responses.
I will engage with participants in written and digital communications in a healthy and respectful manner. I will follow all guidelines about written and digital communication with participants.

I will seek guidance about what is locally appropriate when taking photos or videos. I will always follow Compassion and church dignity standards and will respect the wishes of people I want to be in the photograph or video.

I will be careful about my appearance, language, expressions of affection and other actions to ensure that my behavior demonstrates a respect for participants, their families, their culture and their rights. I will follow any recommendations provided to me.
I will not solicit a romantic/dating relationship and will never engage in sexual/sexually suggestive behavior with any participant, regardless of age.

I will never use language, including language in the form of suggestions or advice, that is verbally, emotionally or spiritually abusive, sexually suggestive, degrading, humiliating, shaming, coercive or is otherwise culturally inappropriate with a participant or their family/caregivers.

I will not engage participants or their families in an inappropriate or culturally insensitive way. I understand that everyone’s comfort with appropriate physical affection is different. I will act in a manner that supports everyone’s personal boundaries and will not engage in any kind of physical contact with others unless they are comfortable.

I will never use any kind of physical discipline or physical punishment as a method of correction during programmatic activities. I will always use non-violent discipline methods to manage participants’ behavior.

I will never travel alone with a participant except in an emergency where circumstances require immediate movement to protect against serious physical injury or death. If a life-threatening emergency occurs, I will make all possible efforts to implement child safeguards when traveling.
I will never visit a participant or their caregiver(s) outside the bounds of acceptable program standards or trips and visits expectations.

I will not disclose personal or private information about a participant, former participant or their family/caregiver to individuals outside the program except where it is done in compliance with required child protection reporting or is mandated by law. I will not publish personal or private information without the person’s permission. I understand that the principle of keeping participant information confidential applies even if I no longer have any affiliation with the participant, child and youth development center, Compassion International, and/or International Partner.
I understand the Code of Conduct for Child and Youth Protection and Safeguarding may be updated in the future and commit to keeping myself informed of any updates.

I understand that if I am unable to affirm adherence to any updated Code of Conduct for Child and Youth Protection and Safeguarding, I will inform Compassion immediately. They may require me to cease involvement with Compassion, Compassion’s International Partners, any beneficiaries, beneficiaries’ families or Child and Youth Development Centers.

li.div: I have read and fully understand the content of the Code of Conduct and agree to ask questions about anything I did not understand.

I am aware that if I violate the Code of Conduct, I may be subject to disciplinary measures, up to and including termination of employment, volunteer or contractor status, Board or council membership, sponsorship, or any other associations I have with the child and youth development center, Compassion International, and/or International Partner.
I understand that any violation by me may subject me to legal action as appropriate.
I understand the Code of Conduct may be updated in the future. I may be asked to review and re-affirm my agreement with the Code of Conduct.

div.p: I therefore agree to comply with Child Protection Code of Conduct and Safeguarding without exception.
